name: Solar Alliance
old_description: Solar Alliance is your engineering, procurement and construction source for solar projects on every scale – from large commercial installations to solar for small businesses.  The Solar Alliance team is committed to helping you meet corporate mandates, evaluate and conserve current energy usage, then save money with solar. Solar Alliance is your source for solar power design in the Southeast and beyond. With years of experience in project management and professionals certified by the North American Board of Energy Practitioners (NABCEP), we have the ability to provide solutions for your commercial solar project anywhere in North America.
about:
Based in Knoxville, Tennessee, Solar Alliance operates as an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm specializing in commercial and community-scale solar energy projects. The company serves clients across the Southeast and nationally, with a noted presence in Tennessee and Kentucky.

Solar Alliance provides end-to-end solar project delivery, including design, engineering, procurement of equipment, construction, and utility interconnection coordination. Its staff includes professionals certified by the North American Board of Energy Practitioners (NABCEP). The company handles projects ranging from rooftop installations for small businesses to multi-megawatt community solar arrays and solar-plus-storage systems for data centers and manufacturing facilities.

The firm works across manufacturing, data center, professional building, agricultural, and utility sectors. Past clients include AAMCO in Lebanon, Tennessee; Faith Lutheran Church in Oak Ridge, Tennessee; and TENTE Casters, Inc. in Hebron, Kentucky. Solar Alliance also develops community solar projects for utilities and offers a Solar 101 continuing education course for industry professionals.

The company emphasizes on-time, on-budget execution and long-term utility relationships to streamline interconnection. It positions its expertise in project management and troubleshooting as a differentiator against newer market entrants, focusing on solutions that align with corporate sustainability mandates and energy cost reduction goals.
